title: Skate Game for Itch.io Jam
author: llamaGames12
selftext:
Hey everyone! 

I'd like to share a very early prototype of Gutter Lines, a skateboarding game I built in just 5 days for the Game Gauntlet Sim Jam. It's held together with duct tape, a lot of wrong decisions, and plenty of bugs. Play: [https://purul3nt.itch.io/gutter-lines](https://purul3nt.itch.io/gutter-lines) 



AI Disclaimer: Built through human + AI collaboration. Totally understand if AI-assisted projects aren't your thing! 

Built with Opus 5.5, SFX Engine, [Leonardo.ai](http://Leonardo.ai), and Blender

I'd love your honest feedback! What's fun, what's broken, and what would you improve? No sugarcoating needed!

 Thanks, and happy skating!
